# QYL0202: High-cardinality tag on metric

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/Qyl.OpenTelemetry.SemanticConventions.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Severity | Warning |
| Category | `Metrics` |
| Code fix | No |
| Analyzer | `Qyl0202HighCardinalityMetricTagAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

High-cardinality tags like user.id, request.id, or session.id create a unique time series for each distinct value. This can overwhelm metrics backends with memory and storage costs. Consider using these values as span attributes instead, or aggregate them into buckets.
